controls.title: Governance and accountability (responsible contact)
controls.description: The entity demonstrates a commitment to accountability; a responsible privacy/security contact is published.

controls.title: Communication of privacy commitments (notice)
controls.description: The entity communicates its objectives and privacy commitments to data subjects via a clear notice.

controls.title: Logical access security safeguards (encryption)
controls.description: Logical access controls and encryption protect information assets during transmission and at rest.
controls.source_section: Common Criteria - Logical and Physical Access

controls.title: Access authorisation and least privilege
controls.description: Access to data and systems is authorised, modified, and removed based on least privilege.
controls.source_section: Common Criteria - Logical and Physical Access

controls.title: Security monitoring and logging
controls.description: The entity monitors system components and logs for anomalies indicative of security events.

controls.title: Security incident response
controls.description: The entity responds to identified security incidents through a defined incident-response program.

controls.title: Vendor and subservice organisation management
controls.description: The entity assesses and manages risks associated with vendors and business partners under contract.

controls.title: Backup, availability and recovery
controls.description: The entity maintains, monitors, and tests backup and recovery to meet availability commitments.

controls.title: Confidential data retention and disposal
controls.description: Confidential information is retained only as long as needed and disposed of per commitments.

controls.title: Consent and choice for personal information
controls.description: The entity obtains consent or provides choice for the collection of personal information.

controls.title: Data subject access and correction
controls.description: Data subjects can access, correct, and request erasure of their personal information.

controls.title: Cross-border and third-party disclosure governance
controls.description: Disclosures of personal information to third parties (including cross-border) are governed and tracked.
controls.source_section: Privacy Criteria - Disclosure to Third Parties
